QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_18

answer.text: Unlisted companies with established business model and track record, often including buy-outs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 1.2.2, PE invests in unlisted companies with established business (vs VC which targets early-stage). **The Trap:** Listed/bond/commodity-only are incorrect for PE. **Cross-Exam Context:** Cat II AIF territory. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Differentiate VC vs PE when pitching — both are alternative but target different maturity stages.
